paragraphs: Bounce Imaging sells throwable and deployable 360° cameras that let tactical teams see inside a space before sending people in. From the moment the device lands it delivers 360° video, thermal, audio and environmental awareness. Pit Viper 360 gives tactical, defense and rescue teams a panoramic thermal view of dangerous spaces, streamed directly to the devices they already carry.

Teams get live 360° video and audio inside rooms, stairwells and confined spaces before personnel enter. The same cameras can be left in place for persistent observation, with live video and audio over WiFi, 4G and MANET. Listed uses include high risk warrants, search and rescue, and room and building clearing. A defense specific version of the Explorer series cameras comes in at 2/3 of the weight, enhanced for military end users with an internal wifi booster, additional encryption and increased waterproofing.

The cameras are fielded by law enforcement, military and emergency-response teams operating in high-risk environments. Its news page reports that Pit Viper 360 was named to TIME's list of the Best Inventions of 2024. It also reports new TSM-enabled cameras powered by TrellisWare as part of $11M in new contracts with DoD. The company raised a $4.2 million Series A Prime round and added a former Pentagon chief to its board.
